review_evidence: Reviewed all 20 primary TetraGray files. The project mixes raytracing implementation with a substantial geometric-algebra layer used to represent relativistic spacetime calculations.

The hydrated source contains 264 declaration-style items, including multivector basis/accessor definitions, inner and wedge products, dual/reverse/grade operations, versors, bivector operations, coordinate transforms and ODE constructions.

The Clifford module also contains explicit theorem declarations such as `e0_scalar` and `e1_x`; the mathematical geometric-algebra definitions are useful formal prior art even though other modules are application code.
summary: Reviewed TetraGray; its theorem-bearing Clifford/geometric-algebra and relativistic-coordinate constructions make whole-source retirement lossy, so the unit is retained.
